title: Privacy policy popup h2 affected by letter-spacing on tldraw.com
reason: The reported privacy-dialog title inherits host-page letter spacing. Several comments propose an override in the upstream analytics package and adding a test, but the retrieved discussion does not confirm a merged fix.

varveAssessment.assessment: The report concerns the upstream SDK analytics popup under host CSS; Varve's privacy and consent surfaces were not inspected.

title: Visiting tldraw.com lands on your workspace instead of your most recent workspace or file
reason: Requests that the bare tldraw.com URL restore the user's most recent file/workspace instead of a default workspace. This depends on upstream account and workspace routing; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No analogous hosted account navigation requirement was inspected for Varve.

title: Include the board name in a board's social preview
reason: Requests board-specific social preview titles across published/shared routes with a fallback for unnamed boards. The sole reply supports the request but does not establish an implementation.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is metadata for upstream hosted boards rather than Varve's static marketing pages.

title: Evaluate Nix flakes for dev environment setup and onboarding
reason: Proposes evaluating Nix flakes as a reproducible alternative or supplement to upstream monorepo setup scripts. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve already documents a confirmed native/Linux toolchain and environment commands; no Nix migration is justified by this upstream proposal.

title: Add startup time to the performance metrics we measure
reason: Requests tracking editor startup time alongside interaction performance metrics, motivated by user-facing responsiveness and regressions. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A useful measurement idea; Varve startup benchmarking was not inspected in this assessment and should be compared with its existing performance harness before action.

title: Dragging an embed fails when the pointer starts over a link inside it
reason: Reports embedded iframe link targets consuming pointer input and preventing the parent editor's embed-drag interaction from beginning. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve iframe/embed drag path was inspected or reproduced from this report.

title: Flip directional geo shapes to their corresponding shape (rhombus ↔ rhombus-2, arrows)
reason: Requests mirrored directional geo shapes to switch to a matching type. Comments suggest representing the operation with flipX/flipY state; support is positive but no settled implementation contract is recorded.

varveAssessment.assessment: A potentially useful design feature, but Varve shape reflection semantics and serialization were not inspected.

title: Deselection after editing shape text inconsistent when tool locked
reason: Describes differing Escape/deselect transitions between text-tool input and text edited inside locked shape/arrow tools. The maintainer closes it pending a broader reconsideration of tool-lock semantics.

varveAssessment.assessment: Do not isolate a keyboard fix from Varve's own tool-lock contract; no local repro was performed.

title: Paste shapes proportionally when pasting into a different frame
reason: Requests preserving relative placement when copying between frames, including frames of different dimensions. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A plausible workflow enhancement, but clipboard frame mapping and user expectations need Varve-specific review.

title: Flipping group containing cropped image by drag resize shifts image position
reason: Reports a crop-mask image shifting or mirroring incorrectly when a parent group is flipped through a corner-handle resize. The one reply praises the demonstration but provides no fix or resolution.

varveAssessment.assessment: High-value transform regression lead. The attachment was not replayed and no Varve group/crop reproduction has been performed.
